name: Mojito
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime juice.
Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice.
Pour the rum and top with soda water.
Garnish and serve with straw.

name: Old Fashioned
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Place sugar cube in old fashioned glass and saturate with bitters, add a dash of plain water.
Muddle until dissolved.
Fill the glass with ice cubes and add whiskey.
Garnish with orange twist, and a cocktail cherry.

name: Negroni
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Stir into glass over ice, garnish and serve.

name: Whiskey Sour
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake with ice.
Strain into chilled glass, garnish and serve.
If served 'On the rocks', strain ingredients into old-fashioned glass filled with ice.

name: Dry Martini
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass.
Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.

name: Daiquiri
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain in chilled cocktail glass.

name: Margarita
description: A tequila cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice to make the salt stick to it.
Take care to moisten only the outer rim and sprinkle the salt on it.
The salt should present to the lips of the imbiber and never mix into the cocktail.
Shake the other ingredients with ice, then carefully pour into the glass.

name: Cosmopolitan
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake well and double strain into large cocktail glass.
Garnish with lime wheel.

name: Moscow Mule
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Combine vodka and ginger beer in a highball glass filled with ice.
Add lime juice.
Stir gently.
Garnish.

name: Pina Colada
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Mix with crushed ice in blender until smooth.
Pour into chilled glass, garnish and serve.

name: Mai Tai
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain into glass.
Garnish and serve with straw.

name: Cuba Libre
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Build all ingredients in a Collins glass filled with ice.
Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Tequila Sunrise
description: A tequila cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour the tequila and orange juice into glass over ice.
Add the grenadine, which will sink to the bottom.
Stir gently to create the sunrise effect.
Garnish and serve.

name: Bloody Mary
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Stirring gently, pour all ingredients into highball glass.
Garnish.

name: Black Russian
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour the ingredients into an old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir gently.

name: White Russian
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour vodka and coffee liqueur over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass.
Fill with light cream and serve.

name: Espresso Martini
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour ingredients into shaker filled with ice, shake vigorously, and strain into chilled martini glass

name: Aperol Spritz
description: A sparkling cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Put a couple of cubes of ice into 2 glasses and add a 50 ml measure of Aperol to each.
Divide the prosecco between the glasses and then top up with soda, if you like.

name: Gin Fizz
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake all ingredients with ice cubes, except soda water.
Pour into glass.
Top with soda water.

name: Tom Collins
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar.
Shake well.
Strain into a collins glass alomst filled with ice cubes.
Add the club soda.
Stir and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

name: French 75
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Combine gin, sugar, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled champagne glass.
Top up with Champagne.
Stir gently.

name: Bellini
description: A sparkling cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour peach purée into chilled flute, add sparkling wine.
Stir gently.

name: Caipirinha
description: A other cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Place lime and sugar into old fashioned glass and muddle (mash the two ingredients together using a muddler or a wooden spoon).
Fill the glass with ice and add the Cachaça.

name: Manhattan
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Stirred over ice, strained into a chilled glass, garnished, and served up.

name: Boulevardier
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Stir with ice, strain, garnish and serve.

name: Sidecar
description: A brandy cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake well and strain into cocktail glass.

name: Aviation
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake well and strain into cocktail glass.
Garnish with a cherry.

name: Clover Club
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Dry shake ingredients to emulsify, add ice, shake and served straight up.

name: The Last Word
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.

name: Paloma
description: A tequila cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Stir together and serve over ice.

name: Penicillin
description: A other cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake blended Scotch, lemon juice, honey syrup and ginger syrup with ice.
Strain over large ice in chilled rocks glass.
Float smoky Scotch on top (be sure to use a smoky Scotch such as an Islay single malt).
Garnish with candied ginger.

name: Gin Basil Smash
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Muddle Basil leaves (~ 10) with Suggar Syrup in a shaker.
Add Gin an Lemon Juice.
Filter and serve in a tumbler with ice

name: New York Sour
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake blended whiskey, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass.
Float claret on top.
Decorate with the half-slice of lemon and the cherry and serve.

name: Old Cuban
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake a handful of mint, 2oz white rum, 1oz of sugar syrup, 1oz lime juice and 2 dashes angostura bitters with ice.
Double strain into a glass and top with 2oz of prosecco.

name: Dark and Stormy
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: In a highball glass filled with ice add 6cl dark rum and top with ginger beer.
Garnish with lime wedge.

name: French Martini
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes.
Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.

name: Sex on the Beach
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
Garnish with orange slice.

name: Sea breeze
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Singapore Sling
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain into highball glass.
Garnish with pineapple and cocktail cherry.

name: Pisco Sour
description: A brandy cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Vigorously shake and strain contents in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then pour into glass and garnish with bitters.

name: Vesper
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake over ice until well chilled, then strain into a deep goblet and garnish with a thin slice of lemon peel.

name: Zombie
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Blend at high speed for no more than 5 seconds.
Pour into a glass, add ice cubes to fill, then add the garnish.
*Donn’s mix: Bring 3 crushed cinnamon sticks, 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of water to a boil, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat and let sit for at least 2 hours before straining into a clean glass bottle.
Then add 1 part of the syrup and 2 parts of fresh grapefruit juice together.

name: Hemingway Special
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake.

name: Irish Coffee
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Heat the coffee, whiskey and sugar; do not boil.
Pour into glass and top with cream; serve hot.

name: Grasshopper
description: A other cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake briskly and then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Champagne Cocktail
description: A brandy cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Add dash of Angostura bitter onto sugar cube and drop it into champagne flute.
Add cognac followed by gently pouring chilled champagne.
Garnish with orange slice and maraschino cherry.

name: Americano
description: A aperitif cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour the Campari and vermouth over ice into glass, add a splash of soda water and garnish with half orange slice.

name: Alexander
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

name: Angel Face
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass.

name: Between The Sheets
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes, shake, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

name: Casino
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist and a maraschino cherry.
Serve without a straw.

name: French Connection
description: A brandy cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir gently.

name: Autumn Garibaldi
description: A aperitif cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Pour all ingredients into a glass over ice and stir with a bar spoon.
Garnish with some orange slices.

name: Kir
description: A sparkling cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Add the crème de cassis to the bottom of the glass, then top up with wine.

name: Ramos Gin Fizz
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive classic character.
method: Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white.
Pour all the ingredients into a shaker.
Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush.
Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes.
It depends on how long you can resist!
Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste.
Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.

name: Rusty Nail
description: A other cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour the Scotch and Drambuie into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

name: Sazerac
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Rinse a chilled old-fashioned glass with the absinthe, add crushed ice, and set it aside.
Stir the remaining ingredients over ice and set it aside.
Discard the ice and any excess absinthe from the prepared glass, and strain the drink into the glass.
Add the lemon peel for garnish.

name: Stinger
description: A brandy cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour in a mixing glass with ice, stir and strain into a cocktail glass.
May also be served on rocks in a rocks glass.

name: Tuxedo Cocktail
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with a cherry and a twist of lemon zest.

name: Bramble
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Fill glass with crushed ice.
Build gin, lemon juice and simple syrup over.
Stir, and then pour blackberry liqueur over in a circular fashion to create marbling effect.
Garnish with two blackberries and lemon slice.

name: Pornstar Martini
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass.
Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish.
Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.

name: Russian Spring Punch
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour the ingredients into an highball glass, top with Sparkling wine.

name: Tipperary
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Stir over ice.
Strain into chilled glass.
Cut a wide swath of orange peel, and express the orange oils over the drink.
Discard orange twist.

name: Martinez 2
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass and fill with ice.
Stir until chilled, and strain into a chilled coupe glass.

name: Godfather
description: A other cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir gently.

name: Godmother
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour vodka and amaretto into an old-fashioned glass over ice and serve.

name: Dry Rob Roy
description: A aperitif cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch and vermouth.
Stir well.
Strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with the lemon twist.

name: Mint Julep
description: A whiskey cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: In a highball glass gently muddle the mint, sugar and water.
Fill the glass with cracked ice, add Bourbon and stir well until the glass is well frosted.
Garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Mimosa
description: A sparkling cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Ensure both ingredients are well chilled, then mix into the glass.
Serve cold.

name: Gimlet
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Add all the ingredients to a shaker and fill with ice.
Shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass or an Old Fashioned glass filled with fresh ice.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Gin And Tonic
description: A gin cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour the gin and the tonic water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

name: Vodka Tonic
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Wash and cut 1 wedge and 1 slice of lime or lemon.
Fill a tumbler with fresh ice.
Pour the desired dose of vodka and top up with the tonic.
Squeeze the lime wedge into the glass and decorate with the slice.
That's all, very simple: it's just the recipe for happiness!

name: Rum Sour
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar.
Shake well.
Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

name: Amaretto Sour
description: A other cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Shake and strain.
Garnish with a cherry and an orange slice.

name: Blue Lagoon
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Pour vodka and curacao over ice in a highball glass.
Fill with lemonade, top with the cherry, and serve.

name: Blue Hurricane
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: If each part is 1/2 oz then use about 2.5 cups of ice.
Blend it all together.
Drink it with a big straw if you have one.

name: Rum Runner
description: A rum cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.

name: Screwdriver
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Mix in a highball glass with ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Harvey Wallbanger
description: A vodka cocktail with a distinctive character.
method: Stir the vodka and orange juice with ice in the glass, then float the Galliano on top.
Garnish and serve.
